title: ‘Bachelorette’ Star Taylor Frankie Paul Responds to Leaked Video of Domestic Incident as ‘Tonight Show’ Cancels Her Appearance
summary: A rep for the ABC star, whose season of 'The Bachelorette' is set to air Sunday, fired back at the video going public: "Releasing an old video, which conveniently omits context, on their son's birthday is a reprehensible attempt to distract from his own behavior."
